subject: Stinky's Kittens and Doggies 2 Business Profile
overview: Anna Callahan interviewed Joanne Keith regarding the history of Stinky's Kittens and Doggies 2 and the shop's adaptation to the COVID-19 pandemic. Keith discussed the business's transition to online retail and its focus on locally sourced holiday gifts.

items.title: Business History and Name Origin
items.summary: Joanne Keith shared the 25-year history of her business, including its move to Somerville 20 years ago and its naming after a show cat named Miss Stinky.

items.title: COVID-19 Impact and Operational Changes
items.summary: Keith described losing the majority of her staff and shifting focus to online sales, curbside pickup, and delivery to maintain operations during the pandemic.

items.title: Holiday Merchandise Showcase
items.summary: Keith demonstrated a range of holiday gift items, including pet-themed towels and mugs, while noting she prioritizes sourcing from local vendors.

items.title: Online Store and Somerville Delivery
items.summary: The shop provides online ordering for pet supplies and giftware, offering free delivery within Somerville and a holiday shipping deadline of December 18th.
